crime: {WITCH_NAME} had told one girl about the little sister she raised and what happened to her. During an argument in the dining hall, that girl spoke the sister's name, and {WITCH_NAME} fell silent. Within a week, anyone who wanted her quiet used it.
That evening, the girl said it again. She always took the last shower. {WITCH_NAME} left with the group before her, then doubled back, telling a prisoner with a comb that she had forgotten her soap.
In the steam, she stood between the girl and the door and heated the air until the girl was fatally burned. She left just before lockup. The guards found the girl dead beneath taps that had run cold.

The burns had blistered beyond anything the prisoners' usual shower water caused. Another source of heat had been there. {WITCH_NAME} said she had left with the others and returned only briefly. But one prisoner had seen her go back, and another had watched the door until she finally emerged near ten.
fields.epitaph: Her heat kept out every hand, but not the name she had entrusted to one.
fields.epithet: The Heat That Answered to a Name
execution: A sealed glass flask held her standing above a low, steady fire. The flask disabled her magic. Heat built up inside its thick walls. The prisoners watched through the glass as she stopped moving. The fire continued beneath her.

magic.name: the Standing Heat
magic.text: She can make the air around her hot enough to scald others without burning herself.
